notes.title: Warrior Balance and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Update 3.08


 Warrior Mounds spawn number increased from 1 -> 2.
 Warrior supply cost reduced from 7- > 6.
 Warrior Armor increased from 5 -> 6.
 Warrior Health increased from 40 ->  45.


 Evo - construction squad - number of builders increased from 15 -> 30.
 Updated the danger level of the first planet levels.
 Updated the evo chamber to force people to get pustules.


Bug


 Fixed a memory leak that was causing some crashes - This took forever to fix…
 Fixed a bug with the warrior armor evo not working.
 Made some updates to how box selection and the circle selection are rendered - this should increase performance.
 Players with a controller plugged in were not getting correct control info for [cameraControls] and [AcceptKey].

notes.title: New Evo's and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bugs:

 Fixed Water Testing Facility having a house in the trees.
 Fixed a bug where fire would follow you between levels or scenes…
 Fixed an issue where several evolutions for the swarmer were not working.

Updates:

 Updated the fire effect to make it more fire-like?
 Updated the trees to be a darker green for better visibility.

New:

 Evolution - Spitter Damage
 Evolution - More Spitters
 Evolution - Faster Spitters
 Evolution - Spitter Armor Shredding
 Evolution - Defender Range
 Evolution - More Defender Health

Balance:

 Updated the Human AI so it would chill out a bit. It was basically sending the whole map at the first minor engagement.
 Updated Nutrient Pustule base swarm capacity gain from 3 -> 2

notes.title: Demo Update 2 - New planet
notes.notes:
New Human AI - they fight back now!
 New forest / jungle tileset
 New forest planet with 5 missions
 New crystal type (its red) - units spawning next to it have 2x health (this can stack)
 New Human Unit - Flamer - terrible evil dirty human who spits fire.
 New Human Building - Flame Turret - static defence that shoots fire.. Very bad, very mean.
 New Human Building - Flamer Academy - building that spawns Flamers.
 New Evolution - Swarmer Mass Breeding - Gives a chance for each spawn to increase spawn amounts by +50.
